_note: 'der Ordnung halber' (idiom, 'for the sake of order') has a real whole-word 'der' immediately before 'Ordnung', but with no stem and no trailing ueber/gegen phrase it is still ordinary prose, not a citation. This also protects against the related substring bug (missing \\b before der/des/dem, which could otherwise match 'der' inside 'oDER Ordnung').
